disposition: Disabled identity-preserving material refinement of the existing installed NPC; no new character or body.

reference_provenance.subject: grandpa
reference_provenance.prompt: Create one identity-preserving production sculpture reference for the SAME installed Grandpa character in these two Tetherbound reference images. Image 1 defines his head identity; image 2 defines clothing and proportions. Crop: a single centered three-quarter head and short neck, facing nearly forward, with the complete hair silhouette and ears visible, no shoulders or scarf, isolated on plain pale grey. Refine only anatomical definition and clean sculpted surface quality for image-to-3D head generation: readable deep-set warm dark eyes with modeled lids, grey eyebrows, kind slightly concerned elderly expression, same long rounded nose, same softly squared jaw and short full grey beard and moustache; swept wavy silver hair with the same uneven side curls and part. Preserve perceived ethnicity, elderly age, head width/height, forehead, face likeness, ear placement, hair length and all recognizable features from the references. Art style: stylized premium creature-expedition game character sculpt, warm natural skin, coherent softened forms, crisp actual facial geometry rather than painted lines, restrained roughness, clean rounded clumps of hair and beard. Neutral even studio illumination showing eye sockets, cheeks and lips, no dramatic shadows. No new character redesign, no ornaments, no red accents, no text, no labels, no extra views, no pedestal, no photoreal pores, no heroic younger face. Intended as a faithful face refinement of the existing Grandpa, not a replacement identity.
reference_provenance.inspection: PASS reference: same elderly warm face, swept grey curls, thick brows, long rounded nose, short full beard and kind concerned expression. Single head crop preserves original identity; no wardrobe/body change.

settings.text_style_prompt: Preserve this SAME installed character identity and original UV layout. Only improve exposed facial skin finish with coherent warm skin colour groups matching the inspected image. Preserve eye colour, brows, facial hair, hair, headwear, mask and collar appearance. No freckles, speckles, dramatic baked lighting, new accessories or new identity. The source mesh will be retained; only safely isolated facial-skin albedo pixels will be used.

generation.model_input: installed isolated head with original UVs

generation_scope: One guarded original-UV Meshy retexture of a static isolated installed-head input. Service geometry, rig, materials and other maps are never installed. Only conservative facial-skin albedo pixels are transferred to the complete original body.

rights.basis: Owner-held installed character and inspected original project draft; owner-authorized existing paid Meshy account. No purchase or community publication.

preservation.scope: Original installed NPC; only safe facial-skin albedo pixels changed
preservation.blend: Inward 24-pixel Gaussian attenuation, half strength, service RGBA delta bounded to 18/255 before blending

face_skin_mask.scope: Conservative facial skin only; no geometry or source image modification
